name: auto-mode-red
description: Highlights in red the part of a command that got it blocked by the auto mode classifier, and shows the classifier's reason in red.

modelFallback.title: Ask a model when no pattern matches
modelFallback.description: When none of the risky-command patterns match a blocked command, ask a small model which part got it blocked.

model.title: Fallback model
model.description: The model asked when no pattern matches: an alias such as haiku, or a full model id.

extraPatterns.title: Extra patterns
extraPatterns.description: More regular expressions to highlight in blocked commands, separated by " ;; " (for example: terraform\s+apply ;; \bprod-db\b).
